gates.title: Benchmark performance and accessibility
gates.evidence: No current benchmark Lighthouse report is present. Current QA is password-protected. Fixture tests and responsive screenshots are not Lighthouse evidence.
gates.action: Load Shopify’s benchmark dataset into an authorized test store, run home/product/collection on desktop and mobile, retain the reports, fix measured failures, and repeat.
gates.acceptance: Recorded averages meet Shopify’s current 60 performance / 90 accessibility thresholds, with manual keyboard and screen-reader checks.

gates.title: Five preset demos and install parity
gates.evidence: Five local candidates are prepared. Only unpublished ULTIMA QA received this upload. Historical ten-brand demos were not upgraded or certified during this pass.
gates.action: Assign a suitable client-transfer demo store to each preset; install the corresponding candidate, use a coherent catalog and realistic content, and compare new installation with its demo. Owner configures or explicitly authorizes required test payment settings.
gates.acceptance: Five industry-consistent demos, install parity screenshots, test checkout configuration and authenticated app/asset inventory. No payment configuration or live publication was changed here.

gates.title: Real Shopify service and browser acceptance
gates.evidence: Native cart, normal variants, Compact media and responsive QA passed. Recipient delivery, enabled pickup locations, eligible installments, large catalogs, combined listings, Markets, real app blocks and full browser coverage have not been certified.
gates.action: Provide authorized fixtures and verify gift recipient email/date, pickup changes, payment terms, discounts/selling plans/quantity rules, native swatches, >250 variants, app installation, localization, product media, search, cart and accessibility in supported desktop/mobile browsers.
gates.acceptance: No unresolved critical journeys; logs/screenshots tied to the same runtime commit. Test checkout orders require a verified test gateway and explicit authorization.

gates.title: Merchant documentation and public support
gates.evidence: config/settings_schema.json still links documentation to main/docs/phase6 and support to GitHub issues. This is not a verified public merchant help center and support form.
gates.action: Approve the public help/support destination and support operator; finish merchant setup, templates, sections, product services, troubleshooting and support policy there. Configure a usable contact form and receipt workflow, then update theme metadata to verified URLs.
gates.acceptance: Public URLs work without a repository login; listing links are correct; support scope, required contact fields and two-business-day response ownership are established.

gates.title: Rights, originality and listing approval
gates.evidence: Brand-kit preview and guide supplied by owner; legal rights, original code provenance, exclusivity and name availability are not proven by a code scan.
gates.action: Confirm source/license provenance and rights to all ten demo brands and media, verify naming availability and Partner account eligibility, finalize commercial listing data and release notes.
gates.acceptance: Owner-approved provenance/asset register and listing. No legal agreement or Theme Store submission was accepted by the agent.

gates.title: Merchant editor complexity and warning triage
gates.evidence: Each candidate has 346 warnings, including 117 excessive-setting counts and 36 Liquid-complexity warnings. A warning is not automatically a rejection; zero errors is not a full compliance certificate.
gates.action: Review actual merchant tasks in each preset, simplify confusing controls, check unused/orphaned code and record an explicit rationale or minimal fix for every remaining warning class.
gates.acceptance: Usable editor flows, reviewed warning dispositions, no hidden feature or broken control in demo walkthroughs.
